_note: Stable building IDs used by the 3D model (object custom properties -> glTF extras -> viewer). Neutral codes (W1, S2, ...) are MODEL identifiers, not official names. Faculty assignment per building is not stated in any supplied or public source and is therefore left unassigned.

bld_main.evidence: Footprint: OSM way 1250092615 (verified against 2022 satellite). Storeys: 3 (verified, frames 5.43 s, 8.88 s, 90.3 s, 135.75 s). Dome on drum: verified (frames 5.43 s, 124.38 s). Name: the video section captioned 'المبنى الرئيسي' shows a 3-storey, 3-pavilion facade with a 'MAIN BUILDING' sign; matched to this building by facade composition, storey count, forecourt kerbs and its position on the Gate No. 1 axis (high-confidence estimate).
bld_main.description: Three-storey building on the axis of Gate No. 1, with a white ribbed dome on a windowed drum. West facade: three projecting pavilions with paired giant columns, a sandstone-clad ground floor and a glazed central entrance with a 'MAIN BUILDING / المبنى الرئيسي' sign.

bld_w1.evidence: Footprint OSM 1250092614; 4 storeys verified (frame 0.5 s north facade); SfM roof height 18.8 m.
bld_w1.description: Four-storey teaching block (C/E-plan) at the north end of the west column, facing the north star garden.

bld_w2.evidence: Footprint OSM 1250092613; 4 storeys (aerial frames 122.3 s, 124.38 s); SfM roof height 19.0 m.
bld_w2.description: Four-storey teaching block (C/E-plan) in the west column, between Block W1 and the Main Building.

bld_s1.sfm_height_m: roof p75 18.3 (far from drone, weakly observed)
bld_s1.evidence: Footprint OSM 1250092612 (U-plan open to the north); 4 storeys (frames 97.4 s, 122.3 s).
bld_s1.description: Four-storey U-plan teaching block, the west building of the south row. Its courtyard opens north towards the plaza.

bld_s2.description: Four-storey U-plan teaching block in the middle of the south row, next to the fenced sports pitch.

bld_s3.description: Four-storey U-plan teaching block, the east building of the south row.

bld_e1.evidence: Footprint OSM 1250092610 (plan open to the west); 4 storeys; this is the building marked by the green arrow in the supplied WhatsApp image (inferred from viewpoint matching with frame 122.3 s). The arrow's meaning is not stated.
bld_e1.description: Four-storey teaching block at the north end of the east column. The supplied photo marks it with a green arrow.

bld_e2.evidence: Footprint OSM 1250092609; 4 storeys; SfM roof height 18.4 m.
bld_e2.description: Four-storey teaching block at the south end of the east column.

gate_1.evidence: Verified: video shots 003-006 (captioned 'البوابة الرئيسية'), lettering 'EAST PORT SAID.N.UNI', 'جامعة شرق بورسعيد الأهلية', 'بوابة رقم ١'. Position: west fence on the Main Building axis (satellite + OSM approach lanes). Dimensions estimated (about 41 m wide).
gate_1.description: Main entrance from the highway on the west side: a central pier with the university roundel, two vehicle openings under lettered beams, and guard pavilions on both sides.

lm_gazebo_garden.evidence: Ring geometry traced from the SfM orthophoto; finished state (lawns, 5 hexagonal timber gazebos with benches, light poles) verified in frames 128.9 s and 22.0 s. Exact gazebo angles estimated.
lm_gazebo_garden.description: Circular garden at the heart of the plaza: lawns, five hexagonal timber gazebos with benches, and a purple-grey paved ring path with black-and-white kerbs.

lm_sports_pitch.evidence: Outline traced from the SfM orthophoto (22.8 x 44.1 m); artificial turf with markings verified (frame 77.01 s); fenced (frames 33.7 s, 46-52 s).
lm_sports_pitch.description: Fenced artificial-turf five-a-side pitch on the south side of the plaza, in front of Block S2.
